name: Aura: Space Weather Data Explorer
summary:
Discover the universe of space weather with Aura Space Weather Data Explorer. This innovative app brings you real-time data from NASA and NOAA, allowing you to explore solar events in a true 3D environment. Whether you're a space enthusiast, researcher, or just curious about the cosmos, Aura offers an unparalleled experience for visualizing and interacting with solar phenomena. 
With intuitive controls and stunning visuals, immerse yourself in the dynamic world of space weather and gain insights like never
